about_the_game:
Swarmhold is a fast-paced co-op survival game where base-building, roguelite replayability, and tower defense collide. Every run is a fresh start—procedural generation and Blueprint drafting ensure your defenses evolve differently each time.

Walls buy you breathing room, towers escalate into bullet-heaven firestorms, and Builders fight alongside their creations, using abilities to cover weak spots when structures alone aren’t enough.

Do you reinforce defenses, greed for extractors to fuel income, or dive into the fight yourself? With limited time and resources, every action carries weight—and could decide whether your base holds or falls.

Between runs, you’ll unlock new Builders, Biomes, and Blueprints, each introducing fresh strategies and playstyles. Endless swarms and escalating difficulty ensure no two defenses ever play out the same.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or equivalent (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 590 or better (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard

short_description: Build and defend your base in this action-packed co-op roguelite. Draft upgrades each run, adapt your strategy, and survive relentless enemy swarms with friends. Every run is unique—teamwork and quick thinking are the keys to survival.
